# thatmgmt-mcp

MCP (Model Context Protocol) server wrapping the ThatMgmt domain API.
An AI agent in Cursor, Claude Code, or Replit can check availability, get
name suggestions, lock a price quote, and prepare a registration — no
dashboard. Nothing executes blindly: the API exposes no execute endpoints,
so this server plans and prices, never purchases.

- Repo: https://github.com/Thingscorp/thatmgmt-mcp
- npm: `npx -y @thatmgmt/mcp` (MCP client config in README)
- Docs: https://github.com/Thingscorp/thatmgmt-mcp#readme
- Agent skill: `skills/thatmgmt/SKILL.md` in the repo
- Base API: https://api.thatmgmt.com — spec https://thatmgmt.com/openapi.json

## Tools (13)

Public, no key: `tmgmt_health`, `tmgmt_capabilities`,
`domains_check_availability`, `domains_get_quote`.
Tenant (`TMGMT_API_KEY`): `domains_suggest`,
`domains_prepare_registration`, `domains_list`, `domains_dns`,
`portfolio_health`, `portfolio_renewal_risk`, `portfolio_exceptions`,
`orders_dry_run`, `offerings`.

## Flow

1. `domains_get_quote` → locked price (wholesale + itemized 1% cut + total). Show the human.
2. `domains_prepare_registration` (key required) → safety-checked plan. Never executes.
